# Design Homes Pty Ltd

> QBCC-licensed residential builder in South East Queensland, Australia. Builds new homes, duplexes and townhouses, custom homes, Queenslander homes, knockdown-rebuilds, granny flats and renovations across Brisbane, Gold Coast, Sunshine Coast, Ipswich, Logan, Moreton Bay and Redland. Led by builder Harj Tiwana.

- Phone: +61 436 376 001
- Email: info@thedesignhomes.com.au
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 8:00 to 17:00 (AEST)
- Pricing: every build is quoted individually after a site assessment; the cost guides below explain typical cost drivers in Queensland.
